concept: API Gateway: throttling, authorization and caching for REST APIs
tests: Which managed service to put in front of a REST API for throttling, authorization and response caching without servers.
expected: Amazon API Gateway — throttling, authorizers, request validation, response caching, fully managed. Triggers: "REST API", "throttling", "authorization", "caching of responses".
why_not: ALB lacks built-in API throttling and authorization at that level; CloudFront — a CDN without API management semantics; Direct Connect — a network connection.
